notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person
notice.quote: The corporation or transfer agent is not put on notice unless the written notice identifies the claimant, the registered owner, and the issue, of which the security is a part, provides an address for communications directed to the claimant and is received before the transfer.

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer

access.label: The person can see the record

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: (a) No person who participates in the acquisition, disposition, assignment or transfer of a security by or to a fiduciary, including a person who guarantees the signature of the fiduciary, is liable for participation in any breach of fiduciary duty by reason of failure to inquire
